depiction.primary_object: curved left-pointing return arrow with double arrowhead
modifiers: second left-pointing chevron ahead of the arrowhead

readings.meaning: reply all (email or message response to everyone)
return or go back multiple steps

ambiguity: Very similar to a single reply arrow, undo arrow, or rewind icon at small sizes.

example_tasks.task: Send a response to the HOA board about the fence permit
Reply to everyone on the Thanksgiving dinner planning chain
Answer the pediatrician's portal message about booster shots
Respond to the contractor's questions on the kitchen quote
Get back to the tournament organizer with our team roster
Reply to the accountant with the missing W-2 numbers
Reply all to the cabin trip thread with our arrival time and dietary restrictions

example_tasks_es: Responder a todos en el correo de la junta de vecinos
Contestar el mensaje del pediatra sobre la vacuna
Responder al hilo familiar sobre la cena de Navidad
example_tasks_ru: Ответить всем в переписке по квартальному отчёту
Ответить в родительском чате про поездку класса

context_tasks.task: Draft apology for the delayed shipping notice
Confirm attendance for the alumni dinner
Send availability for the panel interview

near_misses.task: Return the defective router to Best Buy
Undo the last database migration on staging
Check email for the flight confirmation code
Sign and return the lease renewal PDF
Rewind the VHS tapes before dropping them off

reasoning: The curved left arrow with a double chevron is the universal UI glyph for 'Reply All' in email clients. While originally an interface action button, it serves well in a to-do list for action-driven tasks centered on replying or writing back to messages and threads, though it is easily confused with a single reply or undo arrow.
